observations: For all three sampled composites, left fixed-original selection and right actual output show matching visible counter glyphs, grayscale background and moving white rectangle.
Upper example is speed curve plus reverse and middle deletion; lower example is trim beginning inside freeze.
This is a low-resolution synthetic counter fixture. Some edge counter glyphs are partially clipped in both columns; it is not a natural advertisement or a typography/readability acceptance.

limits: Fixed same-product V37 renderer selection is not an independent source-time or image-quality oracle.
Synthetic short fixtures; no continuous playback or listening, no natural-ad quality, HDR/VFR or long-project resource acceptance.
Presentation windows cannot extend outside the original authored duration; full magnetic/insert/overwrite/roll/slide editing is incomplete.
Partial-window high-level speed/reverse/freeze, smart-cut/reframe/tracking and affected transition endpoints have explicit gates.
Wheel isolation exposes existing optional dependencies and schema from this machine; clean-machine/bundled-schema acceptance is false.
Rendering complete authored graphs can repeat work per visible window; planner limits do not establish throughput/RSS safety.
No new upstream runtime, online providers, generated media or auto-installed OpenFilm Skills. Full original goal remains active.
